notes.title: Final Update: Hometopia's Development Ends
notes.notes:
Dear Topians,

We want to start by saying thank you—truly—for being part of the Hometopia journey. Your creativity and support have meant the world to our small team.

After an incredible run, we’ve made the very difficult decision to end active development and live operations for Hometopia. While we had bigger dreams for it, funding constraints mean this is the final version. Our team is no longer able to support updates, bug fixes, or new features. 

That said, Hometopia will remain live and fully playable for anyone who owns it—and starting April 2, we’re offering it at a legacy discount of $8.99 so even more players can experience what the community helped build. This is our way of preserving the game and giving fans a chance to enjoy it on their own terms. 

Starting April 2, Hometopia will enter “Legacy Mode”:
[list]
[*] All current content will remain playable
[*] The game will continue to be available on Steam
[*] No further updates, bug fixes, or technical support will be provided
[*] Community spaces like the Steam forums and Hometopia Discord will remain open for players to connect and share; however we will revisit this policy if the Discord becomes overwhelmed with spam or toxic content
[/list]

We heard you in the reviews, discord and discussions that pulling career mode out during development has frustrated many of you. Career mode is still available to play in an older version of the game.  [b]If you'd like to revisit the old Career Mode, just follow these simple step[/b]s:

1. Right-click Hometopia in your Steam library
2. Select Properties
3. Go to Betas
4. Choose "Hometopia Old Career Mode" from the dropdown menu

We know this news may be disappointing—it is for us too. We poured our hearts into Hometopia and dreamed of building it alongside you for years to come. While this chapter is coming to a close, we’re proud of what we created, and even prouder of the community that formed around it.

Thank you for building with us. Thank you for dreaming with us. We hope to create something new together again someday.

— The Hometopia Game Dev Team

notes.title: Hometopia Updates: Revamped Multiplayer, New UI, and More Features Coming Soon!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=oyA_6mbNi4M;full][/previewyoutube]
Hey everyone! It’s been a while since we’ve had a chance to share updates with you all directly. The team at Hometopia has been incredibly busy reworking systems, fixing broken things and adding loads of new features, so we’re happy to finally be able to talk about some of the exciting new Hometopia updates coming soon.

[h3]MULTIPLAYER[/h3]
First of all, we are working on a complete overhaul of our multiplayer system. We’re totally aware of how problematic MP has been in the past, so we are implementing a new system that will allow for seamless co-op play. No more drops or desyncs. Also, the UI flow for getting into a lobby together will be much simpler than before.

That's planned to go live with our next big update this month, Hometopia update 7.

[h3]UI UPDATE[/h3]
Second, we are replacing all the EA placeholder UI with new UI art, which is looking really great. It's more sleek, more intuitive, and more satisfying to use. We'd love to hear what you think about it. It will go live with update 7, but you can check out this sneak peek now:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36312004/985649c218c45ce271457b5e98be9c0135f86f5c.png[/img]

[h3]NEW SOUND AND MUSIC[/h3]
Early Access Hometopia has always been a bit lacking in the ~~ vibes ~~ department, particularly with audio. To remedy that, we have created environmental audio ambience for each location appropriate to the terrain. So Fortuna Shores now sounds like a coastal beach area. Agave Valley sounds like a desert. It makes a big difference in making the locations feel more alive and believable.

Also, to accompany the ambiance, we’ve added new music tracks that give a chill, lofi beats sort of vibe, which really lets you tune out and focus on building. Of course, music is subjective so we’d love to hear your thoughts if you think this musical direction works for the game.

Audio updates are coming this week, in update 6.1.

[h3]CARS AND PEDESTRIANS[/h3]
In addition to the audio, we’re making neighborhoods feel much more active and immersive with the addition of pedestrians and cars. No more empty streets and sidewalks, neighborhoods will bustle appropriately depending on how busy the location is.

That’s planned for September in update 7.

[h3]CAREER MODE?[/h3]
Next, you’re probably wondering what’s next for career mode. We yanked the old career mode for several reasons, but mainly because it did not work particularly well. We are updating it with a cozier, more forgiving and creative version. It's similar to the old career mode, but designed to feel more chill and approachable. 

It's similar to the old career mode, but designed to feel more chill and approachable. It’s got all the same options from before but lets you work in a freer, more rewarding environment. Also, construction projects will now have an optional blueprint template to help beginner builders get into the swing of things.

Expect to see Career Mode in 2025.

Later on, Hometopia’s World mode will finally bring community building to life. Players will be able to construct entire neighborhoods and commercial districts, building out the world map one community at a time. But more on that later….


So, you can see we’ve been busy with lots of exciting stuff in the works! Thanks so much for all the support as we’ve worked through the early access snags. Know that we’re committed to making Hometopia the best builder we can, with tons of new features and content planned for the future. Expect to see regular feature updates posted here in the coming weeks!

Sandbox Mode is an additional game mode in Hometopia that lets you design your dream homes with unlimited resources and complete creative freedom. There are no budget constraints or locked inventory items - build, decorate, and experiment to your heart's content.

[b]Key Features:[/b]

-Unlimited Resources: Access to an endless supply of funds, materials, and furniture to bring your wildest design ideas to life.
-Build in Multiplayer: Team up with up to 4 friends to build without limitations, all in real-time collaboration.
-No Scoring: There are no client requirements in Sandbox! Your house, your rules.
-Experiment and Learn: Try out new design techniques, layouts, and decor styles without any consequences.
-Show Off Your Creativity: Participate in our creative challenges in Discord, showcase your designs, and get inspired by others in the Hometopia community.

Now, let's take a quick look at what other fixes are included in this update:

[b]Patch Notes:[/b]

[b]Gameplay[/b]

-NEW MODE: Sandbox - accessible from the title screen
-Starter home/tutorial house: fixed sink incorrectly rotated 180 degrees
-Version numbering simplified

[b]Performance[/b]

-Across-the-board optimizations. Tons of performance issues, small and large, have been fixed and overall performance should be 10-60% better, depending on system configuration
-Painting performance has been improved
-Painting walls or floors should be much faster and cause less lag than previously

[b]Graphics[/b]

-New and improved skyscrapers in Midtown Heights
-Neighborhood houses have been reworked with more variety in Plaza Lakes and Midtown Heights
-Grass visibility range has been increased and optimized
-Washer dryer combo texture/model fixed
-Lights can once again pass through windows and doors
-Updated shadows (higher quality, less jagged, less light leak)
-Overblown light from candles fixed

[b]Known Issues[/b]

-Grass/ground coloration in some neighborhoods appears wrong or misaligned due to terrain optimization work- will be patched soon.
-A section of The Gables neighborhood has a grassy area on the street - we aren't sure why the HOA decided to seed the road, but mowers will be sent in a patch soon.


Thank you for your continued support as we upgrade the game, and we can't wait to see the amazing creations you'll come up with in Sandbox Mode.

Stay tuned for more exciting updates and features. And as a reminder, if you love Hometopia, leave a review!

Happy building, The Hometopia Team 🏠✨

notes.title: Hometopia Pricing Announcement
notes.notes:
Dear Hometopia Community,

Last week, Unity unexpectedly changed their pricing model to a pay-per-install basis, essentially making all but the biggest free-to-play Unity games unsustainable. This announcement completely blindsided us and all other indie developers using Unity. With Hometopia's Early Access launch planned for next week, the timing is particularly difficult, but we didn’t want to delay our planned September 27th release.

We had planned for Hometopia to be a free-to-play game with optional DLCs that players could choose to purchase to upgrade their experience. Unity’s new pricing model means we have to charge for the game, and we deeply regret that. This has been an impossibly difficult decision for us.

[b]Hometopia will be priced at $19.99 during Early Access, which will begin on September 27th.[/b] The planned ‘Builders Pass’ DLC (with 1,000 new items and premium biomes) originally priced at $19.99 will now be included in the game upon initial purchase. All Builders Pass updates and additions that were planned for EA will now be automatically added into the game at no additional cost.

We will also be offering a 15% launch discount.	

We are truly sorry to make this change so close to launch, but this is the only way we can bring Hometopia to you and continue to support it for years to come. Our promise to you is that we will always listen to our community, lead with transparency, and do everything in our power to deliver the best game we possibly can.

Thanks for your understanding and your continued support.

[b]To give you an open forum to ask questions directly, we will be hosting an AMA on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/hometopia-604380109109198850]Discord[/url] at 3pm EST on Wednesday, September 20th.[/b]

notes.title: Unlock Your Creativity in Hometopia with These Four Customization Tools
notes.notes:
How is it that Hometopia players can make so many distinct creations? Today, we’ll walk you through some features that will take your builds to the next level: material customization, the color wheel, scaling, and duplication.

[h2]Material Customization[/h2]
Choose among dozens of material types to bring your exact vision to life. Textures include suede, tweed, raton, leather, corduroy… the list goes on! Choose glossy materials to make your interior shine, matte materials for a more muted look, or anything in between. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36312004/bd6b2c6ecb1bd5ec26488aff8725dbdbc841bae4.png[/img]

[h2]Color Wheel[/h2]
Choosing your ideal furniture is just the beginning. Next, take to the color wheel to make nearly limitless changes to the color of your furniture, your walls, and even those throw pillows. 

Select a hex code to update your space with the exact color you have in mind. Find your inspiration from anywhere and import the exact color through this novel feature. End that long-lasting search for the perfect royal blue, or a gray with a tinge of green–just dial in the code and make your furniture pop! Also, Hometopia saves your color choices, so as you move from one item to the next, you can ensure a unifying aesthetic across your design. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36312004/b6a874dc405a38ee19758a16f532ca695b7ec9f4.png[/img]

[h2]Scaling 
[/h2]
Have you found the perfect fireplace, carpet, or other item in the Hometopia inventory, but are having trouble fitting it in your space? Don’t sweat it! You can scale items to meet your design needs. The Feng Shui wouldn’t be right without it! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36312004/090de65f5dec7620240bc86418cacac9d974fd77.png[/img]

[h2]Duplication 
[/h2]
And one more thing–if you’ve customized the details of your furniture to your liking, you can easily duplicate it and paste that piece anywhere else in your home. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36312004/ba8e8a7d3780336d48a24e94836e4a99a9e53fbf.png[/img]

With these four features, you can let your imagination run wild!

notes.title: A Deeper Look Into Hometopia’s Dynamic Job System
notes.notes:
Hey there, Topians!

As we get closer to release, we wanted to highlight the exciting features that will be a big part of your Hometopia experience, starting with the [b]Dynamic Job System[/b]. 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36312004/aa4b502e7d9cdb7287e32e790d0aaaa0d8278fb4.jpg[/img]

[b]Complete jobs. Earn money. Build your dream home. 
[/b]
At the heart of our Dynamic Job System are client work orders. As you set off on your career as a professional home builder and designer, you'll choose from a variety of tasks, from fixing up a quaint little room to designing an entire mansion. Clients have diverse traits and tastes, and some might be more quirky, or demanding, than others. Based on the client request, the size, difficulty, and payout of each job vary, keeping your renovation journey interesting and engaging, and helping you level up your homebuilding skills.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36312004/094964b0b20d1914d7d379c39ced347c41efab7e.jpg[/img]

[b]Types of Client Jobs
[/b]
As your experience level in Hometopia grows, you'll unlock a variety of jobs across different neighborhoods. Here are some types of client jobs to look forward to:

[list]
[*] [b]Renovation:[/b] Redecorate an empty or dirty room.
[*] [b]Backyard Construction: [/b]Build a beautiful backyard with items like sheds or fire pits.
[*] [b]Additions: [/b]Add a new room to an existing property.
[*] [b]Landscaping:[/b] Refresh the client's yard, creating everything from playgrounds to Zen gardens.
[*] [b]Guest Houses: [/b]Construct a detached guest house in the property's yard.
[*] [b]Full Build Construction: [/b]Build a client's dream home from the ground up, deciding the number of bedrooms and bathrooms and creating additional special rooms along the way.
[/list]
Each of these job types will be represented by unique icons on your map. Before you accept a job, here's a quick rundown of what you'll see:

[list]
[*] [b]Client's name[/b]
[*] [b]Job budget[/b]
[*] [b]General objective[/b]
[*] [b]Potential payment[/b]
[*] [b]Time remaining[/b]
[*] [b]Client preferences[/b]
[*] [b]Skills used:[/b] Each job will require you to flex different skills. Hone these skills, and you might just unlock some pretty cool vanity rewards.
[/list]
Jobs are always changing, so you'll see a fresh batch of client needs and objectives coming in regularly.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36312004/7fa70440c78aa54c24ffa232f1f94df071fec16e.jpg[/img]

Once you complete a job, you’ll receive payment and experience based on how much the client liked your work. You’ll then have the ability to add the job to your portfolio, where you can revisit it in the future and even show it off!


[b]Playtest Opportunity
[/b]
Interested in getting a sneak peek into the Dynamic Job System? We’ve got you covered. We’re beginning to roll out playtests to our Ambassador community, [url=https://www.hometopia.com/wishlist-on-steam?utm_source=st&utm_medium=st_owned&utm_campaign=djs1]which you can apply to here[/url]. 

The playtest gives you a glimpse into the full gameplay flow - tutorial, jobs, player homes, and more. 

Remember, this is just the beginning. Hometopia is a world that will continue to evolve, and we're thrilled to have you with us on this journey. As we head towards the free game release, stay tuned for more updates on the Dynamic Job System and other features!


Happy Building,
The Hometopia Team

notes.title: What are dynamic jobs?
notes.notes:
Happy new year Topians! We hope 2023 brings all of us many amazing things!

Today, we are excited to share with you an update about one of Hometopia's new features: Dynamic Jobs.

At the end of 2022, we discussed what our development team has been working on: Finishing up our dynamic job system. However, what exactly is a dynamic job? And how does that impact my Hometopia experience? Well, I’m here to tell you everything you need to know about it. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36312004/3cec7a239b1b4dc35ec2048bf0c0a6d46ec67a43.jpg[/img]

Dynamic jobs are what we call client jobs, and are an important part of our career campaign. Working your way up in your career as a home renovator, you get to choose jobs, from a variety of different clients with different traits and desires who may need you to improve, fix or build something in their house, and the jobs related to it not only range in size and difficulty, from small, low-paying, relatively quick jobs to large, high-paying, time-consuming ones, but also, the requirements for each job varies according to the neighborhoods they are located.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36312004/487c276e296642b4f6fb2805d24bce1a0ba17c28.jpg[/img]

To ensure that the challenges and jobs are always fun and interesting, we designed a really cool system in which properties have randomly generated interiors as well as the clients and their quirks. Additionally, the client jobs are refreshed after a certain period of time to ensure you always have new clients and jobs available.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36312004/3e32108fe04fd23ee3e43ebbbfa1ff753f642569.gif[/img]

The client will provide you a budget to complete the job, and you will be paid once you have completed the job. The payment received from working on client jobs can contribute to the creation of your dream house, a house you can build in our sandbox mode (a feature we will discuss with you all in the future).

Client jobs will be available during our release on 05.05.2023, so get ready to get your hands dirty and become the best home renovator Hometopia has ever seen! 

Feel free to ask us any questions down below and as always, talk to you next time.

Happy Building! 
Mariana.

notes.notes:
Hello Topians! 🏠🏠🏠

Alex here.  My team and I have been working tirelessly over the past three years on Hometopia and I’m sure you’ve been wondering what exactly has been going on lately. You keep hearing about a new release date and then are understandably confused when nothing comes out. I’m here to explain the last six months, the next six months, and the exciting future of Hometopia!

This game has had a wild ride and up till now, we’ve been entirely self-funded.  Game development in general is complex, messy and expensive. By the beginning of 2022, we didn’t think we could afford to bring you the big experience we wanted to provide.  We could have pushed out what we had, but I didn’t feel right doing that.  We have an obsessive goal that centers around a single vision for Hometopia:

[i][b]Building Community Together[/b][/i]

We want to provide the world, environment and tools to give you the creative freedom to really express yourself.  But even more importantly, we want to help you foster relationships and social ties with other players as you build amazing neighborhoods and communities together! To reach that goal, we realized we needed a partner that can help us take it to the next level.  

After six months of long conversations and work towards full alignment on the vision, we are happy to announce we have partnered with [url=https://www.everyrealm.com]Everyrealm[/url] as a joint venture for Hometopia!  They are not only providing all the resources we need to help bring you the game you deserve, but also have a unique perspective that helps us see the broader ecosystem.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36312004/b5873d5c87b5afe24cbdb09683e917c27483eca3.jpg[/img]

Now onto the fun stuff…

We are building at 100% capacity and pushing every day to bring a truly amazing experience to you soon.  The first thing that comes with that is[b] transparency[/b] and [b]frequent updates[/b]. Starting next week, our very own Mariana will be giving you an inside look into what we’re working on and provide frequent updates documenting our journey.  Keep an eye on the #updates channel in our [url=https://discord.gg/cnxs98zQah ]Discord[/url] for that.

Next, we plan to share our [b]Roadmap[/b] so you can see our plan and timeline. Carl, who comes from AAA gaming, recently joined as Game Director and has been working crazy hard on getting this together. We can’t wait for you to see what we have in store for you!  From our initial launch, all the way through updates and expansions, we think you’re going to love what Hometopia is becoming.

Another exciting change is we finally have our home at our official website domain, [url=http://www.hometopia.com]www.hometopia.com[/url] :)

Lastly, we’ve decided to make a big change to the game…

notes.title: Hometopia Developer Update
notes.notes:
The time has come for an update on development and for us to open a window into some awesome new features that we’re excited to be sharing with you!

This will be the first of many updates, but to get the ball rolling this post will showcase a snippet into one of the more underrated features of a property, yet incredibly vital, the windows! Now you may be thinking that windows can’t be all that exciting but get a load of this…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36312004/2d696b3dd0c3e8d07a17c8a74dd898bcd76a0902.gif[/img]

One standout feature concerning our windows is how they react with the outside world, if the window is in the direct path of the sun, then rays of sunshine will shimmer through the window creating a visible beam of light, making even the smallest dust particles sparkle. However on the other hand, if a window isn't in the direct path of the sun, the game will still produce realistic levels of indirect lighting, ensuring that the room is still sufficiently lit.

There’s a whole world outside of the walls of your property in which you’ll be free to fill the sky with the golden glow of a sunset or a cold darkness, all by manipulating time within the time of day wheel.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36312004/a3dac09219e017f6aaceeecea030afbca519fe95.gif[/img]

If you happen to be a fan of fresh air and beautiful sunsets, then renovating and designing properties will be a breeze as you’ll be able to freely place windows anywhere on a wall that you desire, all whilst creating dynamic lighting and shadows. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36312004/9d74ff5bff65b72937cc7467d823fbcbe76becfa.jpg[/img]

Our large catalog of windows can be interacted with to either open or close at will, in both the overview and first person camera mode. With a vast range of windows at your disposal, you’ll be able to let your creativity flow and create the properties of your wildest dreams.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36312004/df035540c31a69a6331414e9caae947e541f98c5.gif[/img]

The lighting magic doesn't stop there though, as to ensure the visual experience is as similar as possible to the real world, lights will react differently depending on the surface and texture type, making it easier to create the most mesmerizing scenes and renovations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36312004/f1b220f99286cd2f060bb42bb25ad09f5dcee8a6.gif[/img]

We also wanted to give you an update on the launch time frame of the game. We are aware that it is no longer Q2 2020 which is our current Steam launch window, as many of you have suspected we will not be launching the game in 2020. We are working hard on the games development and making it the best possible version it can be. We can update you all and let you know the game will be launching in 2021. Once we have a better idea of the window we will update that too - for now we will continue to keep these development blogs coming so you have an insight into development! Thanks everyone for your continued support on the project!
